primary.rule: d* = argmax_o (f(o) - median f); PASS iff |d*| <= 100 um and excess >= 3 x 1.4826 MAD

alt_denominator_all_mask_voxels.rule: d* = argmax_o (f(o) - median f); PASS iff |d*| <= 100 um and excess >= 3 x 1.4826 MAD

sides.sign_note: positive o = higher slice index; which side is recto is not established by this builder

T_hi_source: p4-highz sibling branch, logs/sib/p4-highz/thresholds.json (T_hi 233 = p99.9, control 1.129 um L1 surface volume level 0, voxels > 0; frozen 2026-09-26T17:50:05Z)
limitations: The declared rule cannot tell sheet density from an ink layer: T_hi is p99.9 of the sheet slab, so a peak near o = 0 can be the dense sheet itself (tools/sib/p4-tiles-b/test_l3e.py::test_sheet_bump_without_ink).
On a flat layer-free profile with iid noise, the max-over-116-offsets rule passes falsely at a measured rate of 0.17 (test_flat_no_layer_false_pass_rate_measured).
For a flat-topped 10-20 um deposit the declared argmax is defined only to within the half thickness; the half-max centroid is reported as a diagnostic (primary.halfmax_centroid_um), not used as d*.
